items.title: F-017: make sandbox cleanup hermetic on sub-check failure
items.context: fail() uses process.exit(1) which skips finally, leaking a mkdtemp sandbox when a sub-check FAILS. Add a module-level activeSandboxes Set; register each dir in makeSandbox; add a cleanupSandbox(sandbox) helper (rmSync + Set.delete) called from every sub-check's finally; add a process.on('exit') sweep that rmSyncs any still-registered dir. Confined to selfcheck-m3.mjs.
items.userSees: node selfcheck-m3.mjs still prints 'selfcheck-m3 PASS' (sub-checks A-M), and a FAILING sub-check no longer leaves a pos-selfcheck-m3-* dir behind in the tmp dir.

happy.desc: node selfcheck-m3.mjs exits 0 with sub-checks A-M all PASS after the finally cleanup is switched to cleanupSandbox().

edge.desc: A sub-check that fails via fail()/process.exit(1) leaves NO pos-selfcheck-m3-* dir in the tmp dir, because the process.on('exit') sweep removes any still-registered sandbox.

adversarial.desc: The 'exit' handler does synchronous rmSync only and swallows its own errors, so it can never throw out of the exit event; a still-registered dir on exit(1)/exit(2) is still swept.

items.title: F-018: assert LOCK_DIR + holder.json survive the forced break failure in sub-check M
items.context: In checkResumeBreakFailureDiagnostic (sub-check M), after the exit-2 + 'could not break the stale lock' diagnostic assertions, add existsSync(lockDirPath(sandbox)) + existsSync(holderPath(sandbox)) survival assertions mirroring sub-checks H/I. run-batch.mjs throws (POS_FAIL_LOCK_BREAK) BEFORE rmSync(LOCK_DIR), so both survive; the assertion pins that invariant.
items.userSees: node experiments/pos-instrument-replay/selfcheck-m3.mjs prints the sub-check M line starting "M-resume-break-failure-diagnostic PASS: a --resume run whose stale-lock break FAILED became the explicit exit-2 diagnostic", the run now also asserts LOCK_DIR (.batch-ledger.lock) + holder.json survived the failed break, and the overall run still ends "selfcheck-m3 PASS" at exit 0.

happy.desc: node selfcheck-m3.mjs sub-check M PASSES with the added existsSync(LOCK_DIR) + holder.json survival assertion.

edge.desc: If a future change let the failed break partially remove the lock, the new assertion fires with a clear message instead of passing silently.

adversarial.desc: The assertion targets the genuinely-stale lock (dead-pid holder) that the forced-to-throw break could not remove, so a pass genuinely means the break removed nothing.
